reviewContext.issueReference: none: workflowInput; opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-855 (design accepted at Step 3, comm-020082; plans accepted at Step 5, comm-020086)
reviewContext.userProblem: Presentation mode shows one flat per slide and cuts between slides. The same shape on several pages is unrelated separate elements, so slide changes cannot animate shared content (3Blue1Brown/Manim-style transitions).
requiredOutcomes: Optional Visual.linkId (after componentKey) carried through IR types, validation, key order, JSONL and Yjs; documents without linkId round-trip byte-identical.
Duplicate page and Copy shapes from page give copies the source linkId (or the source id, also set on the source) in one undoable batch; every planPaste-based paste strips linkId.

Pure DOM-free planSlideTransition in packages/core/src/presentation returns a serialisable plan: transform/crossfade for uniquely linked same-type pairs, draw-on/grow/fade-in entrances, fade-out exits, staggered paint-order starts, ease-in-out; ambiguous or type-mismatched links do not pair; size mismatch or empty pages cut.

ui-solid runner executes the plan with the Web Animations API over inline SVG with per-SVG scoped def ids; next/prev animate, jumps cut, reduced motion is instant, cancellation leaves no stale layer and the final slide is always currentSlide(state).
Inspector 'Slide link' section shows 'Linked on N pages', Unlink, and 'Apply to linked shapes' (style, optional slide-relative geometry) as single undo steps using replaceVisual only.
No new Command kind; packages/core/src/commands.ts and svg-export unchanged; mise run lint and mise run verify pass.
nonGoals: Document-level transition duration setting (constants are used)
Linking on clipboard paste to another page (user-qa Q1 default)
constraints: Phase 1 only; nodetto-app public repo; no server, auth, deployment code, Rust, or new dev dependencies.
Do not name the field 'group id'.
Strict TypeScript, no any, and no new diagnostics under noUncheckedIndexedAccess in feature-owned files (strict-index gate from slk-00 against baseline ccac2d3).
New CSS uses existing theme tokens only (slk-07 adds no colours or tokens).
Workers run no state-changing git commands; each plan edits only its writePaths and its own progress file; workspace-wide lint/verify gates run only in serial slk-07.
mise run verify gets up to 3 attempts for deadline tests under load; deadlines are never relaxed.
No push; commits stay local on feat/slide-link-animation; no tool attribution in commit messages; no emojis.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: linkId lives at Element.visual.linkId right after componentKey.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: visual is already carried generically by JSONL and the Yjs binding, so only IR types/validate/keyOrder change and legacy documents stay byte-identical (design 2.1-2.3).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Strip linkId centrally in planPaste and add links only via a PasteOptions.linkIds map from planPageElementsCopy, with source updateVisual commands placed before creates.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: All paste/duplicate/component paths go through planPaste, so one strip covers them; updateVisual undo restores the exact visual in one step (design 3.1-3.3).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Planner is pure over Store + registry and emits a JSON-serialisable SlideTransitionPlan; ui-solid only executes it.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Unit-testable without DOM, mirrors prototype smartPlan duplicate-key exclusion (design 4.1-4.2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Runner wraps animated nodes in transform-box view-box wrappers and scopes SVG ids per inlined SVG with scopeSvgIds.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Two slides coexist in one DOM without def-id collisions and node transforms are never overwritten (design 5.1-5.5).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Add a strict-index gate script (slk-00) instead of enabling noUncheckedIndexedAccess repo-wide.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The repo already has baseline diagnostics at ccac2d3; the gate fails only on new diagnostics in listed feature files, captured from a per-invocation extracted tree removed in finally (design 9.1, Step 5 SLK-PLAN-001).

biome.json files.include does not cover .agents/scripts, so biome 1.9.4 would otherwise exit nonzero with no processed files; the plan requires the step to exit 0. slk-07 strict union command is expanded to the concrete file list from the plan, including slk-03 pre-authorised tests (existing files pass when unchanged).

intentionalTradeoffs: Linked shapes of different types fall back to fade-out plus entrance instead of morphing.
Edits to linked shapes stay independent per page; propagation is explicit via 'Apply to linked shapes'.
Strict gate keys diagnostics by (path, code, message) without line numbers.
slk-00 (163 lines) and slk-05 (179 lines) exceed the ~150-line guideline for pitfall detail.
Animation visual quality can only be judged in a real WebView.
supportedEdgeCases: Duplicate linkId on one page is ambiguous and never matched; outgoing copy fades out, incoming copies enter.
Source already carrying linkId keeps it and gets no updateVisual.
Rapid next/next cancels the first layer and plans from the first target to the second.
Toggle black, exit, digits, revision change during a transition.
Reverse navigation pairs the same elements with from/to swapped.
Slide size mismatch or both pages empty -> cut; one empty page -> only fade-outs or only entrances.
Groups are never step targets; their children are planned; hidden/mask-source/prototype-edge elements are skipped.
Grow steps remove markers and restore them via onFinish on finish or cancel.
